markdown: Every engine drags the same path 30 times per family and kind, in its own window (visible), each drag in a witness span; a run took effect when its result is the pinned build's (module header, drag.mjs). `cua:0ms` has no wait after a sample, after the press or before the release.

The judges (T10), for the shipped lane `cua`: every run takes effect; Chrome's and Electron's thumbs land at or past the pinned build's mean distance of the same sitting; the long paths (Chrome's and Firefox's canvas, Chrome's drag and drop in front) pass on warm speed under Acceptance 3's interval rule, topped up to 40 a side. Every other cua lane is measured, not judged.
| family | kind | pinned took | newest took | cua took | cua:0ms took | newest warm ms | cua warm ms | cua:0ms warm ms | pinned warm ms | witness | judges | verdict |
| GTK3 gedit | scrollbar | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 316.2 | 23 | 18.7 | 396.4 | clean | – | cua PASS, cua:0ms PASS |
| GTK 3 scale (harness scene) | scale | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 325.5 | 45.8 | 44.5 | 547 | clean | – | cua PASS, cua:0ms PASS |
| GTK4 gnome-text-editor | select | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 320.2 | – | – | 410.9 | clean | – | no vendor effect: not judged |
| Qt 6 qtcreator | select | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 299.9 | 26.9 | 31.1 | 365.2 | clean | – | cua PASS, cua:0ms PASS |
| Qt 6 qtcreator | scrollbar | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 30/30 | 317.3 | 45.1 | 44.9 | 403.2 | clean | – | cua PASS, cua:0ms PASS |
